# Gent Ford — Coaching for Men

> Gentius Ford’s demonstration coaching website. This is a test site: no appointments, payments, or real form submissions are available. Credentials and client results are not claimed.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Introduction to coaching for men.
- [About Gent](/about-gent): Gentius Ford’s coaching approach.
- [Ready to Work](/ready-to-work): How the proposed work is structured and who it may suit.
- [Your Challenges](/your-challenges): Direction, relationships, boundaries and transitions.
- [The Power](/the-power): Notice, choose and act.
- [Sign Up](/sign-up): Browser-only demo enquiry.
- [Contact](/contact): Browser-only demo contact form.
- [Terms](/terms): Demonstration website terms and limitations.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Data handling for this test.

Coaching is not therapy, clinical treatment, or crisis support. Content on canonical HTML pages is authoritative for this site; this file is an optional discovery aid.
